description:
12 fossils and frozen mummies that still look alive, from a 28,000-year-old cave lion cub with its whiskers on to a 506-million-year-old sea creature that still has its brain. Each one froze at the moment it died, so the fossil is the spoiler, and Doug takes the time machine to that exact day.

Which fossil should Doug visit next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad day.
